name: Hit the nail on the head

meaning.zh:
“一语中的” 或 “切中要害”。

这个短语起源于木工活儿中的比喻，当你将钉子准确无误地钉到正确的位置时，你就做到了 “hit the nail on the head”。这个短语在英语中比喻说话或做事非常精准，直击要点和核心。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from carpentry, where hitting the nail directly on the head ensures it goes in straight, accomplishing the task effectively. In English, this phrase is used metaphorically to describe a situation where someone perfectly addresses an issue or makes a correct or precise statement.

lines.en: You really *hit the nail on the head* with your analysis of the problem.
lines.zh: 你对问题的分析真是一语中的。

lines.en: Her comment about the company's culture *hit the nail on the head*.
lines.zh: 她对公司文化的评论切中要害。

lines.en: When he said that our strategy needed to change, he really *hit the nail on the head*.
lines.zh: 他说我们的策略需要改变时，确实切中要害。
